Discoloration Defense 8/10 12. Simply Clean 8/10 SkinCeuticals is still one of the most scientifically influential professional skincare brands in the industry. Their antioxidant research and clinical credibility remain exceptional. C E Ferulic is legendary, but legendary doesn’t automatically mean 10/10 forever. P-TIOX brings peptides into the conversation, H.A. Intensifier Multi-Glycan is more sophisticated than a basic HA serum, and newer anti-aging formulas are moving the brand beyond its vitamin C legacy. Where they lose points for me: price, some older formulas, and formula elegance compared with newer biotech and advanced Korean skincare. finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
